chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Ja'far, from his father, from Ali (peace be upon him)
That the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) forbade throwing poison in the lands of the polytheists.

key_terms.الْمُشْرِكِينَ: Polytheists/Those who associate partners with God

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet forbid regarding poison in the lands of the polytheists?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on the conduct of war against polytheists, this hadith establishes a specific legal ruling prohibiting the use of poison in the lands of the *mushrikeen*. This ruling highlights the Prophet’s emphasis on preserving the environment and resources of non-Muslim territories during military campaigns, reflecting a broader principle of *adab al-harb* (etiquette of war) in Shia jurisprudence. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the limits of aggression and the preservation of public utility (*maslaha*) even towards those outside the Islamic fold.
